text:
maria: Quick note — noticed a 2.8x jump in median token latency on /v1/chat/stream between 03:00-03:10 UTC. Chunk cadence shows repeated 150–250ms gaps, and we saw 4 stream stalls in prod during the window :eyes:
sam: saw that, started profiling. kernel selection fell back to the generic int8 path around token 32 for long contexts. possible quantized-kernel regression after last runtime rollout.
jon: client vs server breakdown? is it server send delay or client ack slowdown?
dev-runtime: initial traces indicate server-side send is the main offender. timeline from worker: "send_chunk()" -> kernel dispatch -> kv lookup -> chunk_emit. KV miss rate jumped from 2%->18% in the window.
perf-bot: gpu_util avg 72% -> 89% during spike, cpu 43% -> 65%, sm_pcie queue depth spiked. attaching perf counters: GMemLatency=21ms, KernelQueueWait=47ms.
sam: paste of profiling snippet:
```
# flamegraph-like sample
proc: send_chunk
  kernel_dispatch 47.3ms
    select_kernel(int8_fast) -> fallback int8_generic 36.8ms
  kv_lookup 19.1ms (miss)
  network_send 4.6ms
```
maria: interesting — fallback cost >> kv cost per token. suggests kernel selection heuristic misfired for these sequence lengths. maybe the selector mis-classified due to recent shape inference change.
jon: batching heuristics note: we had a change that increases max_batch_wait_ms from 8->12 for streams. that could allow bigger, but also increase tail latency if kernels degrade. revert test? :thinking_face:
dev-runtime: local repro with ablation: force select_kernel to prefer int8_fast -> tail latency back to baseline. forcing kv prefetch reduces kv miss to <1% but only cuts 8% of the overhead.
maria: proposal: 1) add per-route KPI panel in console (median/p95 token-level latency, chunk cadence heatmap), 2) instrument server-side chunk timestamp and client-received ack (to split send vs client), 3) add kernel-selection histogram to runtime metrics, 4) temporary rollback of selector patch if we see more regressions.
sam: PromQL query for token-level breakdown I drafted:
```
# median token latency per route
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le, route))
```
jon: also add metric for kv_miss_ratio{route, model, zone} and a compact log line for every fallback occurrence. low-cardinality to avoid cost.
perf-bot: created /dashboards/perf/stream-token-latency draft, includes heatmap + per-route p50/p95 + kernel-fallback counter. link: https://console.internal/d/stream-token-latency (preview)
maria: next steps: sam run canary with selector rollback + kv-prefetch enabled on one podset, monitor dashboard for 30m. if stable, we push full rollback and schedule follow-up to rework selector.
dev-runtime: I'll instrument server_chunk_send_ts and client_recv_ts in the protocol (two 8-byte ints) and emit delta per-token. low overhead.
jon: add alert: increase in kernel_fallback_rate > 0.5% for 10m AND token_p95 increase > 20% -> page on-call.
maria: thanks all — keep thread updates short. sam, kick off canary and paste results here. :thumbsup:
